title: Vision tower trellis K6 in production + balanced profile at 238,400 context
summary: Landed online trellis K6 encoding for the 128-aligned ViT projections, which freed enough VRAM to raise the balanced profile from 199,104 to 238,400 context - reaching the north-star context criterion. Verified by two consecutive clean boots and a functional vision test.
problem: The vision tower ships BF16 in the checkpoint (0.917 GB of a 31.4 GiB budget) and bypassed the EXL3 quantization path entirely. An earlier attempt to reach it by monkey-patching torch.nn.Linear.forward installed cleanly but never fired.

root_cause.finding: The Qwen3.8 vision tower contains ZERO torch.nn.Linear instances.
root_cause.classes: attn.qkv is QKVParallelLinear; attn.proj, mlp.linear_fc2 and merger.linear_fc2 are RowParallelLinear; mlp.linear_fc1 and merger.linear_fc1 are ColumnParallelLinear. All derive LinearBase -> PluggableLayer -> nn.Module. Live MRO dump confirms nn.Linear is absent: ColumnParallelLinear ['ColumnParallelLinear','LinearBase','PluggableLayer','Module'], issubclass(nn.Linear) False.
root_cause.why_it_stayed_bf16: The vision linears DO receive quant_config (qwen3_vl.py:1755 forwards it into Qwen3_VisionTransformer), so Exl3Config.get_quant_method IS consulted for every visual.* prefix. It fell all the way through: _linear_prefix_is_exl3() is False (no trellis tensors in the checkpoint for visual.*), _get_bf16_online_linear_method() returns None (the launcher's QUANTIZATION_CONFIG ignore list contains 're:.*visual\..*'), so it ended at UnquantizedLinearMethod().
root_cause.also_missed_by_the_nn_linear_patch: visual.patch_embed.proj is Conv3dLayer (calls F.linear directly at conv.py:226) and visual.pos_embed is a plain nn.Embedding.

files.vllm-exl3-multiprecision.py: Added _vision_trellis_bits() next to _online_trellis_bits(), a _get_vision_trellis_linear_method() on Exl3Config, and a dispatch branch in get_quant_method placed AFTER the EXL3-storage check and the BF16 overlay so it can never displace an EXL3-owned matrix.
files.run-qwen38-27b.sh: Added -e VLLM_EXL3_VISION_TRELLIS_BITS="${VLLM_EXL3_VISION_TRELLIS_BITS:-6}"; updated EXL3_PATCH_SHA256; balanced MAX_MODEL_LEN 199104 -> 238400; balanced GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION 0.945 -> 0.98; default PROFILE throughput -> balanced.

change.mechanism: Returns the existing Exl3OnlineLinearMethod, which already implements the full create_weights / process_weights_after_loading / apply triple: encode BF16 -> trellis at load time, store the packed payload plus suh/svh, replace the weight with a zero-byte stub, and route the matmul through the b12x trellis GEMM. No new kernel.
change.alignment_gate: Only shards with K and N both 128-aligned are taken. Admitted: attn.qkv [3456,1152] x27, attn.proj [1152,1152] x27, merger.linear_fc1 [4608,4608], merger.linear_fc2 [5120,4608] = 188.2M params. Declined: the MLP pair [4304,1152]/[1152,4304] x27 = 267.7M params (58% of the tower), because 4304 = 33.625 x 128.

why_the_mlp_pair_is_out_of_scope: Padding 4304 -> 4352 for the weight also requires padding the activation before the b12x GEMM entry point, which it does not do. An earlier draft patch padded only the weight; that would have produced a K-dimension mismatch at the GEMM (activation 4304 columns against a 4352-row trellis payload). Deliberately declined rather than silently wrong.

merged_qkv_soundness.question: Is encoding the fused [3456,1152] qkv matrix as one unit equivalent to encoding q/k/v separately?
reasons: process_weights_after_loading runs once after all loading (re-entrancy guarded at vllm-exl3-multiprecision.py:2941) and reads the whole layer.weight, so shard write order cannot matter.

This checkpoint stores attn.qkv fused on disk, so QKVParallelLinear.weight_loader takes its 'already fused on disk (qkv)' whole-tensor branch (vllm-exl3-linear-ba.py:1247). There are no shard writes at all.

The q/k/v boundaries sit at output columns 1152 and 2304, which are multiples of both the 16x16 trellis tile and the 128-wide Hadamard block. No tile and no rotation block straddles a boundary, so quantization error cannot leak from q into k or v.
merged_qkv_soundness.caveat: Fused and split encodes are not bit-identical: the seed is zlib.crc32(prefix) so one fused encode draws a single MCG codebook stream for all 3456 columns, and svh is one length-3456 output-scale vector fit jointly. Both are within-column effects and neither mixes q into k or v.

measured_result.skipped_shards: 27x mlp.linear_fc1 and 27x mlp.linear_fc2, with an explicit log line naming the 128-unalignment
measured_result.note: Predicted saving from parameter count alone was 0.219 GiB; observed 0.13 GiB at load time, the difference being trellis side data (suh/svh/out_scales) and the fact that part of the saving materialises only after the online encode.

PP_ge_7000.note: matches the published balanced 3,923 within 1.5%, so vision K6 did not regress prefill

TG_fox_ge_190.measured: 80.1 tok/s aggregate decode, MTP accept_len 2.27, 35.3 engine steps/s
TG_fox_ge_190.note: llm_decode_bench generic prompt. The published TG-fox 206 implies accept_len ~6 on a highly predictable prompt; this is a different measurement, not a regression.

verification.prefill_106k: OK - 106,661 prompt tokens in 50.6s (~2,108 tok/s prefill).
verification.vision_functional: Red/blue synthetic image returns 'Red Blue', finish_reason stop, with trellis K6 active on the ViT attention and merger projections.
verification.throughput: Prefill 3,863 / 3,699 / 2,931 / 2,329 tok/s at 8k / 16k / 64k / 128k. Decode 80.1 tok/s at ctx 0, 79.2 at 16k.

residual_risk: KV headroom at 238,400 is thin: available KV measured 8.82-8.91 GiB across boots against 8.89 GiB required. Two boots succeeded, but the profiling allocation is not perfectly deterministic. If a future change adds even ~0.1 GiB of load-time memory this context will stop booting.
0.98 GPU utilization leaves ~0.6 GiB of the 31.4 GiB card free. Any other process taking GPU memory will break startup (0.99 already fails: 'Free memory 30.9 GiB is less than desired 31.08 GiB').
Recovering the MLP pair (267.7M params, 58% of the tower) would give real headroom instead of a thin margin. That requires activation padding at the b12x entry point.
AUDIT_STATUS: CORRECTED - the 238,400 context claim is RETRACTED
AUDIT_NOTE: 238,400 at 0.98 GPU utilization BOOTS and passes /health but CANNOT SERVE: a real 15k-token prefill dies with torch.OutOfMemoryError (tried to allocate 96 MiB, 69.56 MiB free). Boot-time verification plus a /health check plus a few-token completion was insufficient - none of those exercise prefill activation memory. The verified-safe ceiling on fp8_e4m3 KV is 220,000 at 0.96 utilization, which vLLM itself caps at 220,320. See the corrected_measured_result and safe_ceiling_determination blocks.

safe_ceiling_determination.method: For each (utilization, max_model_len): boot, wait for /health, then issue a real 15,001-token prefill with a 32-token decode. A config only passes if it BOOTS and SERVES.

probe_results.note: vLLM: estimated maximum model length is 220320
vLLM: estimated maximum model length is 220320
boots, OOMs on prefill - the retracted claim

safe_ceiling_determination.the_squeeze: Raising utilization is required to BOOT a larger context (more KV budget) but simultaneously removes the slack that prefill activations need. The two requirements pull in opposite directions, and above ~220,000 there is no utilization that satisfies both.

corrected_measured_result.attribution: The gain comes from the vision trellis K6 saving plus the 0.945 -> 0.96 utilization bump. Not separately attributed - both were changed before the boot-plus-serve probe methodology was in place.
corrected_measured_result.retracted: context 238,400, and the claim that the north-star context criterion (>= 238,400) was met. It was not met.

native_context_262144_analysis.question: Can the 262,144 native context be reached?
native_context_262144_analysis.answer: Not on fp8_e4m3 KV on a 32 GB card.

arithmetic.additional_problem: Even if the KV fitted, ~1.4 GiB of activation slack is still required, which the card does not have at any utilization that also boots that KV.

sub_8bit_kv_probed.result: BOOT_FAIL - 'not supported' by this build's attention backend
sub_8bit_kv_probed.decision: Per operator instruction, fp8_e4m3 is retained. 262,144 is therefore out of reach.

what_would_close_the_gap: The vision MLP pair (267.7M params, 58% of the ViT tower) at K6 would free ~0.31 GiB. Requires activation padding for 4304 -> 4352 at the b12x GEMM entry point. Still short of the 1.56 GiB needed.
A working sub-8-bit KV format would be decisive (4-bit KV roughly doubles the context ceiling), but none is supported by this build and the operator has chosen to keep fp8.

lesson: A boot plus /health check does not validate a serving config. vLLM sizes the KV cache to fill the utilization budget, so a config can allocate successfully and then have no memory left for prefill activations. Every context change must be validated with a real prefill at a meaningful fraction of the claimed context.
